sections.title: Contributors to population change in Scarborough
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component, %

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Scarborough, between 2025 and 2028:

  • More deaths than births meant that the population decreased by 7,813 people (−7.2%). In total, there were 7,840 births and 15,653 deaths in Scarborough between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in England) increased the population by 7,683 (7.0%). There were 53,622 people entering the area and 45,939 people leaving the area between 2025 and .
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) led to a fall in the local population in Scarborough of 301 people (−0.3%), as a result of 1,641 people entering the area and 1,941 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Scarborough's population of 2,525 (2.3%).as a result of 5,859 people entering the area and 3,334 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
